how: Fenxing Fencing Club, listed as China's first privately run fencing club, teaches members from young children to adults at the Sports Museum by the east gate of the Olympic Sports Centre.
Beijing Seidokan Judo teaches traditional judo to adults and children in English at the German Embassy School in Liangmaqiao.
J-Ballet School runs adult ballet classes (RMB 80 per class, 10-lesson packages) in English, Chinese or Japanese at the Kempinski/Lufthansa Centre and Sanlitun.
Beijing Aofan Sailing Club offers sailing courses for children, teenagers and adults at all levels, and rents boats, at the Olympic Water Park in Shunyi.
Golden Sail Water Sports Club on Houhai, home of the Beijing Dragon Boating team, lists rowing and canoeing among its activities.
Golden Sail Water Sports Club on Houhai lists windsurfing among its activities; the listing gives no lesson details.
Golden Sail Water Sports Club on Houhai lists water skiing among its activities; the listing gives no lesson details.
The Beijing Bombers (founded 2003) train most weekends at Dulwich College, open to anyone regardless of age or ability, and play the annual China Cup against the Shanghai Tigers.

Beijing has an active frisbee scene with an estimated 150+ clubs (2022 report) and the annual Beijing Frisbee Open, whose 5th edition drew 11 teams and 300+ players at Tongzhou Yunhe Olympic Sports Center in May 2026; club sessions cost roughly RMB 50-150.
venue: Beijing Frisbee Open / local frisbee clubs
area: Tongzhou Yunhe Olympic Sports Center, Tongzhou

how: The Beijing Guild, a weekly crafters' group, meets for knitting and crochet in Chaoyang cafes on Tuesday afternoons and Thursday evenings (2018 listing) and runs paid monthly skill workshops.
Yipiantian Pottery Studio teaches a one-hour beginner class (RMB 198) that includes wheel practice, with longer courses; The Pottery Workshop and others operate nearby.
Yipiantian Pottery Studio's one-hour beginner class (RMB 198) includes handbuilding from scratch, with a glazed piece to take home; Taozui Pottery and Pengcier also offer hand-made pottery sessions.

Citizen orienteering races are run in Beijing, for example the Zhongguancun sports carnival race at Xishan Forest Park (Oct 2025, 500 participants) and city-wide events registered via the Beijing Fitness mini-program.
venue: Zhongguancun Street orienteering race, Xishan National Forest Park

how: Piano centres such as Ao Yue Piano Center (tutors from the Central Conservatory, about RMB 100/hour) and Beijing Yilun Piano Center teach lessons, and private teachers advertise English/Chinese courses on The Beijinger classifieds (2026).
Private teachers advertise beginner to advanced guitar lessons on The Beijinger classifieds (June 2026), and Let's School offers guitar, drum and bass classes.
Beijing Mindfulness Centre near Yonghegong hosts meditation rooms and regular weekly sessions at about RMB 100 per session.
Let's School, founded by the heads of School Bar, was reported in 2018 to teach guitar, drums, bass and studio production classes.
